chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 211: Peng Longteng – A Skinless Victory at the Border Pass
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang stuffs the Thousand Greats Record under his own skin and burns the battlefield alive. But Peng Longteng’s headless corpse still has one last swing. A brutal, visceral climax.
og_title: Ch. 211: Peng Longteng – The General Who Wouldn't Fall
og_description: A desperate, skin-shedding battle. Li Huowang trades his humanity for a single killing blow—but the horror doesn't end with decapitation.
twitter_title: Peng Longteng – Li Huowang just tore off his skin to win a fight. It worked. Then the headless body stood up.
twitter_description: The Army Shriek, the skinless Thousand Greats graft, and a general who loves being burned alive. This chapter is pure, savage Chinese horror-action.
